summary.name: Android Studio
summary.one_liner: Google's official integrated development environment (IDE) for building Android apps, based on IntelliJ IDEA, with a download page for Windows, Mac, Linux and ChromeOS.
use_cases: Testing apps on real devices via device streaming
Emulating phones, tablets, foldables, Wear OS and TV devices
Managing multiple build variants with Gradle
summary.what_it_does: Android Studio is the official IDE for Android app development, offering a code editor, Compose design tools, and a Gradle-based build system that can generate multiple build variants from one project. The Build Analyzer helps find build performance issues. The Android Emulator lets developers test apps on many device types, including phones, tablets, foldables, Wear OS, TV and ChromeOS. Android Device Streaming runs apps on real devices from within the IDE. The page also offers AI agent assistance for generating and fixing code and answering questions, and standalone command-line SDK tools with sdkmanager.
notable: Official Android IDE built on IntelliJ IDEA
Integrated Android Emulator and real-device streaming
Gradle build system with Build Analyzer
Standalone command-line SDK tools with sdkmanager
caveats: Downloading requires accepting the Android Software Development Kit License Agreement
Installers are large, about 1.3 to 1.6 GB per platform
Page does not state pricing explicitly; listing marks it as freeware
